paper_title: Exotic energy injection in the early universe II: CMB spectral distortions and constraints on light dark matter
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, read from Fig. 10 axis)
notes: The paper recasts CMB anisotropy constraints on decaying DM (ALP->gamma gamma) into a bound on the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (Fig. 10), for ALP masses ~2R (27 eV) to ~10 keV. This is a cosmological bound, not a haloscope, so no local DM density is assumed. The exclusion curve is shown only graphically in Fig. 10 with no numerical table; data points here are rough estimates read from the plot axis and should be treated as approximate. The y-axis spans g_agamma ~1e-21 to 1e-12 GeV^-1 over ALP masses 10 to 1e6 eV.
